claim: A doorway to the street is one frame from the street to the room side of its leaf: its leaf sector and reveal do not wear the room's carpet, chequers or office ceiling. Blood's sills, jambs and heads under wooden doors are planks: tiles 20 and 68 led both lists over 192 doorways to the open (counted 2026-11-25 for apertures.py, no kept count, not recounted); E1M3 s135, a sliding door, wears 20 as its head and two of its walls.
evidence: the owner, 2026-11-25: 'some door around city has floor and ceiling in door aperature area from the room inside, so from the outside it looks bad, I would give it some neutral textures or something' (projects/blood-city/level/apertures.py:89-91)
E1M3 s135 (type 614): ceiling tile 20, walls 200, 20, 30; the 192-doorway count is apertures.py:81's, not kept
use: Paint a doorway from the street through the leaf with one neutral frame material; apertures.neutral does it over a finished map.

checked.how: Owner's words at projects/blood-city/level/apertures.py:89-91 (neutral docstring): 'some door around city has floor and ceiling in door aperature area from the room inside, so from the outside it looks bad, I would give it some neutral textures'. The 192-doorway count (:81) has no kept tool or file. E1M1 s59 is a type 602 sector of 26 walls (floor 294, walls 1718/479) and s90 a type 614 of 44 walls (floor 504, walls 421/1011): no planks.
